ideas.title: Investigating the Use of Force by Federal Agents
ideas.description: This story would investigate the use of force by federal agents, including the shooting of Alex Pretti, and examine the policies and procedures in place to prevent such incidents.
questions: What are the policies and procedures in place for federal agents to use force?
How often do federal agents use force, and what are the consequences?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover systemic issues with the use of force by federal agents and to hold those in power accountable. I recommend starting with a review of existing policies and procedures, and then conducting interviews with experts and those affected by the use of force.
